name: Dub – Short Links With Superpowers
author: steventey

sections.description:
This is the official WordPress Integration for Dub.

Features:
– Automatically create short links when a new post is published
– Edit short link slugs directly inside WordPress
– Track conversion events from link click to account signups
sections.faq:
1. How can I configure the WordPress plugin?

    Once you activate the plugin, go to the settings page ( It is under Settings => Dub ) and enter your Dub API key. You can find instructions on how to create an API key on our website.

  2. Is the plugin free to use?

    We have a generous free plan at Dub that you can use to shorten and create up to 25 links a month. For higher limits, upgrade to our Pro plan.
